entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_02
entries.text: I’m startin’ off bids for this lot at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nLet the auction begin!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_05
entries.text: SOLD to a very discernin’ customer for the tidy\nsum of [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_10
entries.text: SOLD to the young la[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]dss! Nice goin’!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_06
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This lot is yours for the keepin’! That’ll be
[VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)],
please
and
thanks.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_07
entries.text: ...Hrm? Seems you don’t have the funds to cover\nyer bid there. ’Fraid that voids the sale, kid.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_08
entries.text: Hope to see you next time!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_a_09
entries.text: Welcome, welcome! Anythin’ catch yer eye?

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_00
entries.text: Come over and have a browse!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’ll start this lot off at...[VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!
All
right,
folks!
Let’s
hear
your offers!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_03
entries.text: The highest bid stands at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nAnyone willing to go higher?

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_05
entries.text: SOLD to the savvy bidder here for [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_10
entries.text: SOLD! Well done to the young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_06
entries.text: You topped out the bidding at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nHere’s your goods, dear.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_07
entries.text: ...Oh? You don’t have enough money to cover\nyour bid, dear! I’ll hang onto this lot for now.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_08
entries.text: Thanks so much for joining in.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_09
entries.text: Oh dear... I’m sorry, young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady, but I don’t\nthink our auctions are for you just yet.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_02
entries.text: OK, amigos y amigas, we start at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nDon’t be shy, now! Bid, bid, and bid s’more!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_03
entries.text: The top bid stands at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]! Anyone else\nwanna jump in?

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_05
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]SOLD to the keen-eyed bidder here for\n[VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_10
entries.text: SOLD to the keen-eyed muchach[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa!\nMuy bien hecho!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_07
entries.text: ...Huh? Wait, you don’t have enough money!\n’Fraid your bid was null and void...\r\nNo goods for you!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_08
entries.text: Hope to see you again, amig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_09
entries.text: Sorry, amig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa, but you need to have more bidding\nexperience to enter our auctions. Another time!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_03
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)] is the standing bid! Can I get a\nbetter\r\noffer?

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_05
entries.text: SOLD to a generous bidder for [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_10
entries.text: SOLD to the young student! Very well done!

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_06
entries.text: Thank you for your generous bid, young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady.\nThat’ll be [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)], if you please.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_07
entries.text: Ah...your pocket money doesn’t cover what\nyou owe. I’ll have to cancel this sale, dear.

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_08
entries.text: Our stock is always of the highest quality.\nDo come and bid again, won’t you?

entries.label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_09
entries.text: Welcome! Care to have a look?

entries.label: sub_003_member_a_02
entries.text: Tch... The price just shot up...

entries.label: sub_003_member_a_03
entries.text: Oooh, I want this lot real bad!!!

entries.label: sub_003_member_e_02
entries.text: Where’d a kid get such money?

entries.label: sub_003_member_e_03
entries.text: Time for this old geezer to shine!

entries.label: sub_003_member_f_03
entries.text: I’m taking this home for sure!

entries.label: sub_003_member_g_02
entries.text: Hrrmph. Not bad for a young ’un!

entries.label: sub_003_member_g_03
entries.text: No way I’m lettin’ this lot go!

entries.label: sub_003_member_g_04
entries.text: Guess I’ll just head on home...

entries.label: sub_003_member_h_03
entries.text: Time to empty the pension pot!
